biggest_catch: This is a loan referral program, not a checking referral - you only earn when the friend actually books and activates a HELOC ($100), auto loan ($50), or Visa card ($25), and you get no visibility into the loan's status.
catches: Referring member must be a Har-co member; referral form signed and verified against signatures on record.
Friend must book and activate a qualifying loan: HELOC ($100 gift card), vehicle loan ($50), Visa loan ($25).
HAR-CO will not give the referring member any information about the loan's status.
No limit on the number of referrals; gift cards may be subject to IRS tax reporting.
Limited-time offer (no fixed end date stated on the page).

steps: Print and fill out the Har-co referral form.
Give the form to friends interested in a Har-co loan.
Friend books and activates a HELOC, auto loan, or Visa loan.
You receive a $100 (HELOC), $50 (auto loan), or $25 (Visa) gift card - no limit on referrals.
timing: Gift card awarded once the referred loan is active; no payout window beyond that stated.
